text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After crossing the finish line of the 
Hakodate Sprint Stakes, Curren Chan felt a 
lingering sense of unfulfillment.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, seeing the passionate reactions 
from the fans on Umatter...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She remembered that in a sprint, she could 
captivate the fans' hearts with a single 
flash of brilliance.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, I don't want to be just a 
fleeting afterimage. I want to keep 
filling the hearts of my fans with 
cuteness.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Taking that as her personal homework, 
Curren Chan headed into summer training 
camp to prepare for the upcoming Sprinters 
Stakes.
